title: Find reliable service information
summary: A practice guide for checking that information comes from an official source.
steps: Identify the organisation responsible for the service.
Look for an official website or verified contact channel.
Read the eligibility and document list carefully.
If unsure, ask the official help desk before sharing personal details.

title: Prepare before starting an online form
audience: People who find online forms confusing
summary: A preparation checklist; it does not submit a real form.
steps: Read the form instructions before entering information.
Ask a trusted helper to explain unfamiliar words if needed.
Review every field before submitting through the official website.

title: Pause before sharing information
summary: Simple reminders to reduce common online safety mistakes.
steps: Do not share passwords or one-time passcodes with anyone.
Check the website address and sender carefully.
Avoid links that pressure you to act immediately.
Use an official contact channel to verify unexpected requests.
